text: Now, those bulkheads. They didn't reach the top of the hull. Most stopped just a few decks above the waterline. With five compartments filling, the bow sank lower, and lower. Until the water spilled over the top of one wall, into the next. Like an ice cube tray, tipped forward. Once that started, nothing could keep the Titanic afloat. At twenty past two in the morning, she broke apart and sank. There were lifeboats for barely half the people on board.
